EXIT AGREEMENT
This Exit Agreement (the Agreement") is made at Lahore on this 26th day of October, 2022 by
and between
Hassan Ahmed Sb Muhammad Ameen, holding CNIC No. 35202-5614920-5.
resident of House No. 154, Mohallah Jahanzaib Block, Allama Iqbal Town, Lahore (the
"Exiting Party");
AND
Usman Shahid Sb Shahid Parvez, holding CNIC No. 35202-2596462-7, resident of
House No. 636. Block P, Mohallah Johar Town. Lahore (the "Continuing Party");
AND
Zameen Media (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan,
with its registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, MM Alam Road, Gulberg Ill. Lahore,
through its duly authorized representative Ms. Mariam Saleem Akbar (the "Zameen")
(Exiting Party, Continuing Party and Zameen shall, where the context so admits,
hereinafter collectively be referred to as the "Parties" and individually as the "Party")
WHEREAS:
(A)

The Parties entered into a Lease Agreement dated 17th August, 2021("Léase
Agreement") for shop No. SF-13 measuring three hundred and eleven (311) sq.ft,
situated at second floor of a commercial building named and styled as 'Square One'.
located at property No. SXX-A-110-B/3/IIl. Gulberg Ill. Lahore (the "Demised
Premises");

(B)

Continuing. Party purchased share of the Exiting Party in the Demised Premises
through a registered sale deed bearing Document No. 2575, Book No. 1, Volume. No.
1089 registered on 25.06.2022 with sub-registrar Gulberg Town, Lahore ("Sale Deed")
and becomes the sole owner of the Demised Premises; and
Exiting Party is desirous to exit from the Lease Agreement as per the terms and
conditions of this Agreement.

(C)

Now THEREFORE, it is hereby agreed between the Parties as under:
Exiting Party has sold his share in the Demised Premises to Continuing Party through a
registered Sale Deed. Consequently, the Continuing Party now becomes the sole and
absolute owner of the Demised Premises, therefore Exiting Party shall cease to be a party
to the Lease Agreement with effect from 15h August, 2022 ("Exit Date"). Copy of Sale
Deed is attached in Annexure A.
Due to the sale of Exiting Party's share in the Demised Premises, the Exiting Party no
2.
longer has any obligations and rights under the Lease Agreement and therefore is being
discharged from the Lease agreement. Consequently, the Exiting Party will have no
